body.heading: Where in the world is Morocco?
paragraphs: Morocco is a country in Northern Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Morocco is Rabat.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Morocco is Arabic.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Morocco is the Moroccan dirham.

body.heading: How big is Morocco?
paragraphs: Morocco covers about 447,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Nigeria.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Marrakech's great square fills at dusk with drummers, storytellers and food stalls, while the souks nearby are a treasure-maze of lanterns, rugs and spices.
High in the Rif Mountains, Chefchaouen's lanes are painted every shade of blue — one of the prettiest small towns in the world to wander with a camera.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Morocco on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Morocco in one breath: a country in Northern Africa, capital Rabat, where people speak Arabic and pay with the Moroccan dirham.
